title: Nonparametric Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Mixtures of Logistic Regressions
abstract: arXiv:2611.14445v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixtures of logistic regressions provide a flexible framework for modeling binary responses, extending standard logistic regression to accommodate unobserved heterogeneity while retaining an interpretable regression structure. In this paper, we study such models with an unspecified mixing distribution. We analyze a sieve nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) and derive nonasymptotic bounds on the estimation error of the resulting mixture regression function under both fixed and random designs. Our results reveal an explicit tradeoff between statistical estimation error and the approximation error induced by the sieve radius, from which we derive convergence rates under several tail conditions on the mixing distribution. For computation, we propose a finite-particle algorithm that approximates the sieve NPMLE by optimizing the locations and weights of a finitely supported mixing distribution. translated_title: 逻辑回归混合模型的非参数极大似然估计
translated_abstract: 逻辑回归混合模型为二元响应建模提供了一个灵活的框架，它在保留可解释回归结构的同时，扩展了标准逻辑回归以适应未观测到的异质性。本文研究了混合分布未指定的此类模型，我们分析了筛法非参数极大似然估计量，并在固定设计和随机设计两种情形下推导了所得混合回归函数估计误差的非渐近界。我们的结果揭示了统计估计误差与筛半径引起的近似误差之间的明确权衡，并由此在混合分布的若干尾部条件下推导出收敛速度。在计算方面，我们提出了一种有限粒子算法，通过优化有限支撑混合分布的位置和权重来近似筛法NPMLE，该方法在数值上具有优势。
tldr: 本文针对混合分布未指定的逻辑回归混合模型，建立了筛法非参数极大似然估计的非渐近误差界与收敛速度理论，并提出了高效的有限粒子计算算法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes nonasymptotic estimation error bounds and convergence rates for the sieve nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator of logistic regression mixtures with unspecified mixing distributions, and proposes an efficient finite-particle algorithm for its computation.
